name: Cicor Technologies Ltd.
summary: Cicor Technologies Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of electronic components and systems worldwide. The company operates in two divisions, AMS and ES. It develops and produces rigid, rigid-flexible, and flexible printed circuit boards; thin and thick-film substrates and hybrid circuits; and printed electronics. The company also provides outsourced electronic manufacturing services in the fields of printed circuit board assembly, microelectronic assembly, box building and system assembly, control cabinet construction, cable assembly, tool design and fabrication, and plastic injection molding. It serves industrial, medical, aerospace and defense, watches and consumer, automotive and transport communication, and other markets. Cicor Technologies Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Boudry, Switzerland.
